about: Fetch benchmark commitment. The private 30% is NOT in this repo; only its hash is.
private_file_definition: sha256 of the private file's bytes: the private items as one JSON list sorted by id, keys sorted, separators (',', ':'), UTF-8, ensure_ascii off, one trailing newline
set_sha256_definition: sha256 of the sorted lines '<sha256 of one item as compact sorted JSON>', one per item, joined by newline (same construction as hidden-set/COMMITMENT.json)
split_method: rank = sha256('<seed>:<item id>'); within gold and within decoys, sort by rank and send the lowest round(0.3*n) to the private part. The seed is private; its sha256 is below.
reveal_policy: Revealed (file and seed) after 5 scored fetcher versions, as the plan says; a new private part is committed before the old one is revealed; never revealed early because of a result.
limits: Proves: the private items existed and were fixed when this file was committed. Does not prove: that the labels are right (one person labelled them), that the set is representative, or that a score was run honestly. Before reveal, outsiders can check only the public 70%.
